topic: EXP-498 P1: §4.2.2 canonical-hub signpost for '0 nT strawman'

holes_found.description: Signpost present-tense claim is premature by 2–3 follow-up EXPs. The inserted sentence states 'later sections that touch on it — Parts 5, 6, 8, 8b, and 9 — cross-reference back here rather than re-deriving the argument.' Verified search for p4-422 anchor links in sections.json finds: Part 5 = 0 cross-refs, Part 6 = 0 cross-refs, Part 8 = 0 cross-refs, Part 8b = 0 cross-refs, Part 9 = 1 cross-ref (the new §9.1 Pattern 10 from EXP-498 P2). Parts 5, 6, 8, and 8b still have Chapman re-derivations (6, 6, 2, 0 Chapman mentions in each; no p4-422 anchors). The claim becomes true only after the deferred follow-up EXPs that EXP-498 explicitly names (part5 kill-shot card, part6 §6.10 collateral). A reader who checks Part 5 after reading the signpost finds re-derivations, not a cross-reference.
holes_found.proposed_fix: Soften to future-tense or add a qualifier: e.g., 'later sections that touch on it — Parts 5, 6, 8, 8b, and 9 — will cross-reference back here as they are progressively trimmed; §9.1 Pattern 10 already does so.' Alternatively, restructure to only claim Part 9 for now and name the remaining sections as targets of follow-up: 'subsequent sections that touch this argument cross-reference back here rather than re-deriving it; see §9.1 Pattern 10 for the first instance.'

summary_for_decider: P1 signpost text confirmed landed in §4.2.2 (anchor seam clean; paragraph flow intact; no orphan punctuation). One minor Check-5 hole: the signpost's present-tense claim that Parts 5, 6, 8, 8b, and 9 'cross-reference back here rather than re-deriving' is premature — verified p4-422 anchor search shows only Part 9 (§9.1 Pattern 10) currently cross-references; Parts 5/6/8/8b still carry full Chapman re-derivations. EXP-498 acknowledged these as deferred. Recommend softening to future-tense or limiting to Part 9 until follow-up EXPs land. Minor edit only — nothing that breaks verdict or requires escalation.
